thread:
Elena: Quick async check on Q2 OKR milestone handoff for the inference rollout — trying to capture what shipped, what slipped, and immediate next steps. Please reply with owner confirmations or short blockers.

Ravi: Shipped: core runtime v2 canary ✅. Autoscale alpha deployed to staging but not prod yet.

Chen: Note: model catalog ingestion slipped — waiting on labeled eval sets from Data. @Maya can you confirm ETA?

Maya: Yep, working with Data. ETA EOD Wed for initial 5 eval sets. Will flag if more needed.

Sam: Docs + SDK updates are queued behind the model catalog work. I can do a minimal SDK patch to unblock devs (PR ready) if we expand canary.

Elena: Owners (proposed): runtime canary -> Ravi; autoscale prod rollout -> Sam + EngInfra; model catalog -> Chen; eval datasets -> Maya (Data coord).

Ravi: Confirmed for runtime canary. I've got a small perf regression to triage (p95 +10ms) — root cause looks like batching change.

Chen: Confirmed for model catalog. Blocker: Data needs a consistent eval schema (we got two formats). Maya, can we standardize a schema by Wed?

Maya: I'll push a draft schema tonight: ```json
{
  "prompt_id": "string",
  "input": "string",
  "expected": "string",
  "metrics": ["accuracy","rouge","latency_ms"]
}```
Should work for the first pass.

Sam: PR #4123 (minimal SDK compatibility) -> link: https://git.redwood/PR/4123. UX changes postponed. If we expand canary after regression fix I can merge and cut a patch.

Elena: Decision needed: expand canary to 20% on staging -> prod if regression fixed and Data provides evals. Vote with +1/-1.

Ravi: +1 if I can roll back quickly (will add a fast rollback hook).

Chen: +1, but only after evals are in and model catalog v0 is validated.

Maya: +1 for rollout gating on schema and the 5 eval sets.

Sam: +1 assuming SDK patch merged.

DevOps Bot: deploy/runtime-canary v2 -> staging succeeded at 2026-03-15T14:02Z :white_check_mark:

Elena: OK — consensus = expand canary after regression fix + evals + SDK patch. Next actions:
  - Ravi: triage perf regression, target fix by EOD Tue.
  - Maya: final schema + 5 eval sets by EOD Wed.
  - Sam: merge PR #4123 after canary regression cleared.
  - Chen: validate model catalog v0 with the evals and report pass/fail.

Ravi: I'll post a brief follow-up with perf diffs and rollback steps once I have a repro.

Maya: Will upload evals to the shared bucket and ping here.

Chen: If model validation fails we revert canary and attach failing cases to the ticket.

Elena: Thanks all. If no objections, consider this the official async sign-off for the narrow canary expansion plan. Short check-ins welcome here — one-line updates are perfect. :thumbsup:
